faq.question: Q1. What is CCBSS Senior Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: Chandigarh City Bus Services Society (CCBSS) has invited applications for the post of Senior Assistant on a contract basis for a period of five years.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Senior Assistant post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the physical application form is 15 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduation in any stream with a minimum of 10 years of experience as a Senior Assistant or Superintendent in a Government, Public Sector Undertaking, or Autonomous Body.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The age should not exceed 65 years as on 1 October 2026.
